_meta.description: Which Claude skills this repo is canonical for, and which sibling repos take a synced copy. Edit skills here, never downstream. Sync: node scripts/sync-skills.mjs --all (check) / --all --apply.
stale_sources: Copies under .claude/skills/global/ (the 2026-05 act-global-skills mechanism) and any skill whose name sits in this repo's .claude/skills/_archive are stale; --apply moves them to .claude/skills/_archive/<date>-stale/ in that repo.
